description: Test class for Mqtt3Validator, containing unit tests that verify the correctness of MQTT connection validation logic, including source address validation, enforcement rules, immutability, and exception handling.

classes.name: Mqtt3ValidatorTest
classes.description: Unit test suite for the Mqtt3Validator class, verifying MQTT connection validation logic including address validation, exception handling, immutability, and configuration correctness.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating an Akka ActorSystem before any tests run.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Shutdowns the ActorSystem after all tests have completed.

methods.name: testImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the Mqtt3Validator class is immutable.

methods.name: testValidSourceAddress
methods.description: Tests various valid MQTT source addresses to confirm they pass validation.

methods.name: testInvalidSourceAddress
methods.description: Checks that invalid MQTT source addresses trigger ConnectionConfigurationInvalidException.

methods.name: testInvalidClientCount
methods.description: Ensures that an invalid client count (e.g., 2 when only 1 is allowed) leads to an exception.

methods.name: testInvalidConsumerCount
methods.description: Validates that invalid consumer counts in source configurations throw exceptions.

methods.name: testInsecureProtocolAndCertificates
methods.description: Checks that insecure protocol configurations with trusted certificates result in an exception.

methods.name: testValidTargetAddress
methods.description: Tests valid target addresses for MQTT connections.

methods.name: testInvalidTargetAddress
methods.description: Confirms invalid target addresses cause exceptions.

methods.name: testInvalidHeaderMapping
methods.description: Verifies that header mapping configurations that are invalid lead to exceptions.

methods.name: testWithDefaultSource
methods.description: Ensures that default source configurations with authentication context are correctly validated or rejected.

methods.name: testInvalidSourceTopicFilters
methods.description: Tests invalid MQTT source topic filters to ensure they trigger configuration exceptions.

methods.name: testInvalidEnforcementOrigin
methods.description: Verifies invalid enforcement origin patterns are correctly identified and rejected.

methods.name: connectionWithSource
methods.description: Helper method to create a connection with a specific MQTT source address for testing.

methods.name: connectionWithTarget
methods.description: Helper method to create a connection with a specific target address for testing.

methods.name: verifyConnectionConfigurationInvalidExceptionIsThrown
methods.description: Asserts that a specific connection configuration throws a ConnectionConfigurationInvalidException during validation.
